WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    c.constructorId,
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(*) as standings_records
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN constructors c ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
),
average_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(standings_records) as avg_records
  FROM constructor_counts
)
SELECT 
  cc.constructorId,
  cc.nationality,
  cc.standings_records,
  ROUND(cc.standings_records - ac.avg_records, 2) as difference_from_average
FROM constructor_counts cc
CROSS JOIN average_calc ac
WHERE cc.standings_records > ac.avg_records
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
